async def act(page):
    # Extract issues with labels related to help needed from the current page
    issues_list = []
    
    # Locate all issue title links in the main content area using get_by_role
    # From the tree, issue titles are links under the main element
    main_element = page.get_by_role('main')
    issue_links = await main_element.get_by_role('link').all()
    
    # Also get all label groups with name 'Labels' under main
    labels_groups = await main_element.get_by_role('group', name='Labels').all()
    
    # Iterate through issue links and find corresponding label groups
    for i, link in enumerate(issue_links):
        link_text = await link.text_content()
        link_href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        # Filter to only include issue links (heuristic: URL contains '/-/issues/' and has text)
        if link_href and '/-/issues/' in link_href and link_text and link_text.strip():
            # Find the corresponding label group for this issue
            # Based on the tree structure, label groups appear after issue links in order
            if i < len(labels_groups):
                labels_group = labels_groups[i]
                # Get all label links within this group
                label_links = await labels_group.get_by_role('link').all()
                label_names = []
                for label_link in label_links:
                    label_name = await label_link.text_content()
                    if label_name:
                        label_names.append(label_name.strip())
                # Check if any label contains 'help' (case-insensitive)
                if any('help' in label.lower() for label in label_names):
                    issues_list.append({
                        'title': link_text.strip(),
                        'url': link_href,
                        'labels': label_names
                    })
    
    # Output the list as a string
    result_str = '\n'.join([f"Title: {issue['title']}, URL: {issue['url']}, Labels: {', '.join(issue['labels'])}" for issue in issues_list])
    print(result_str)
